title: mentha × sativa subsp. parietariifolia
intro: Mentha × sativa subsp. parietariifolia, commonly known as a hybrid mint species, is a plant in the Lamiaceae family that is often used for its unique characteristics and medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion, as well as its ability to act therapeutically on the nervous system to alleviate anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, the plant's essential oils have been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments and promote overall well-being.
